name: Vehicle search
purpose: Starts a search for any vehicle by its registration number, such as to check its tax and MOT: a card the user taps, showing a blank number plate and a search icon, which takes them to where they type the registration.

origin.notes: The app's VehicleCheckSectionView, under Check vehicle details on the Driving screen: a button, not a field, with its label, a blank plate reading ABC in the DVLA's typeface, and SF's magnifyingglass on a primaryBlue circle. The future driving designs keep it, under Check a vehicle, with Start as its label.

href.description: Where it goes, if it's a link: the screen where the user types the registration.

name.description: Its name, if it's a button, to tell it apart when it's pressed.

value.description: Its value, if it's a button.

inputs.content: Its label, such as Search for a vehicle, as the app has it, or Start, as the future designs do. Screen readers hear only this: the plate and icon are hidden from them.

events.name: click
events.description: From its link or button, when it's pressed.

rules: Use it only to start a search for a vehicle by its registration. For other searches, use the search field.
Put it in a section that says what the search is for, such as Check vehicle details, with a description, such as Tax and MOT information for any vehicle.
Make it a link, with href, to the screen where the user types the registration.

references.description: Under Check vehicle details, on the Driving screen, in light mode

examples.name: In a section, as the future driving designs have it
examples.html:
<govuk-app-section title="Check a vehicle" description="View information for any vehicle">
  <govuk-app-vehicle-search name="check-vehicle">Start</govuk-app-vehicle-search>
</govuk-app-section>
